title: Chikari
description: A chikari (drone-string) definition. CANONICAL form is {fundamental, uniqueId} only — its drone pitches are NOT serialized; they are reconstructed as the default drone at `fundamental` on load. Self-contained: not part of the raga context chain (see DIVERGENCES SEM-2). Legacy data may include a `pitches` array. TS and Python agree.

fundamental.description: Center-sa frequency (Hz) applied to the drone pitches.

pitches.description: LEGACY ONLY — omitted in canonical form (reconstructed from defaults).
